Hi Arno

 I'm guessing the problem and put a new version of the tar.gz file at

     http://www.stat.ucdavis.edu/~duncan/nimble_0.1.tar.gz

If you download that via your Web browser and put it in say, C:\nimble_0.1.tar.gz
or some other directory and then within R evaluate the command

  install.packages("C:/nimble_0.1.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")

hopefully that will work.  If so, please let us know.
